The more visual information you give to Pl@ntNet about the plant you are observing, the more accurate the identification will be. There are indeed many plants that look alike from afar and it is sometimes small details that distinguish two species of the same genus. 

Flowers, fruits and leaves are the most characteristic organs of a species and it is them that should be photographed first. But any other detail can be useful, such as thorns, buds or hair on the stem. A photograph of the whole plant is also very useful information, but it is often not sufficient to allow a reliable identification.

Welcome to Beauty Salon, an entertaining game for kids in which every girl can feel like a real master of beauty!
Little beauties just love experimenting with their appearance and become more and more beautiful day by day. In our educational game about the beauty parlor your kids will be able to learn everything that the real girl should know: sew clothes and pick up stylish looks, do pretty hairstyles and elegant manicures, engage in beauty and be the most unpredictable!

• kids dressing up games for little girls
• acquaintance with hairdresser's tools and creating of trendy hairstyles
• mini game for sewing your own clothes
• manicure service and design

~~~ Features of beauty salon games ~~~

~ 5 exciting kids games
Our app contains a large selection of mini-games to teach your child the basics of fashion and beauty. Learn everything that girls like so much: sewing, creating, coloring, picking up, etc. Play educational games for kids with pleasure!

~ Dress-up game and creation of modish looks for little fashionistas
Let your child feel like a real fashionista. Choose items of clothing and try to find an unforgettable outfit. A wide variety of T-shirts, shorts, dresses, shoes and accessories are waiting for you. Let your child try different combinations and put together her own closet.

~ Nail Service Salon
In our children's games for kids, your baby can learn not only how to properly care for nails, but also how to create a colorful manicure. First, use special products (cream, oil, nail clippers, etc.) to treat the cuticle, nail plate and skin of the hands, and then take on the nail polish. Choose a color you like and cover all your nails. Then apply the fun stickers and voila! Your game model's hands are beautiful and well-groomed!

~ Children's hairdressing salon
Every girl from childhood dreams of beautiful and fashionable hairstyles. And what if you learn to do them yourself? Choose the model you want to transform and start the game. Wash her head with shampoo and dry it with a hair dryer. Use curlers to get beautiful curls, and then spritz the hairstyle with fragrant perfume.

~ Mini-game about the clothes sewing
Choose the template of the dress you want to create and get to work. Cut out the patterns and assemble the product according to them. Add colors on the fabric and decorate the outfit with accessories. Kids can try to create a whole fashion collection!
